# User Story Template
#
# Copy this template when creating a new issue for the product backlog.
# The "As a / I need / So that" form keeps every story focused on the user,
# and the acceptance criteria are written in Gherkin so they can be turned
# into Behave/Selenium tests later.

**As a** [role]
**I need** [function]
**So that** [benefit]

### Details and Assumptions

- [document what you know]
- [add any constraints, data, or dependencies]

### Acceptance Criteria

```gherkin
Given [some context]
When [certain action is taken]
Then [the outcome of action is observed]
```
